gotchas: Populate is decoupled from preprocess and prediction-gated (+30 preprocess, +32 predict, +34 populate). Populate seeds pending rows and the predict cohort excludes live labels, so populating before prediction starves an image forever (predict parent docstring; populate_headtail_...activity.py:137-149).

An abstention counts as 'visited' for the populate gate. Abstentions ARE persisted: the cohort selects on absence, so dropping them re-predicts forever (persist_headtail_predictions_activity.py:8-12).

Two different meanings of 'sentinel': the preprocess cohort treats project_id IS NULL as sentinel (API dive_cohort_controller.py:715-729), while populate's 'sentinel' rows carry a project id and completed=False. The predict cohort keys on completed, NOT project id (resolve_headtail_predict_inputs_activity.py:251-255).

Resolvers must mirror their selectors exactly, including canonical-only and the needs_reprocess branch (no laser gate for flagged images), or a dive re-fires every hour forever (resolve_headtail_preprocess_inputs_activity.py:112-133).

needs_reprocess clear is scoped to the checksums actually redrawn. None clears the whole dive and [] clears nothing; don't collapse them with a falsy check. Clearing ignores completed/superseded. Raising requires superseded=FALSE and, by default, incomplete (label_reprocess_controller.py:36-160).

A child that is already running (CHILD_ALREADY_RUNNING) means do nothing more: no cleanup_raw and no flag clear (dive-442 incident, _dispatch.py:200-275). Child reuse policy is ALLOW_DUPLICATE, never FAILED_ONLY.

The predict parent's backfill call is unconditional, and changing that altered the command sequence, so it was deployed against a drained queue. Keep the replay order stable (predict_headtail_images_parent_workflow.py:9-15). An all-skip run must still backfill.
'unavailable' GPU mode means return before dispatch: a child on an unserved queue hangs until its timeout (_dispatch.py:134-158).

The predictor version is a hand-bumped literal ('version the behaviour, not the model'). Fallback is -1 (negative on purpose, so it is permanently stale and forms the upgrade queue). The cohort uses IS DISTINCT FROM so NULL is stale (headtail_predictor.py).
The predict cohort orders never-predicted dives before upgrades, so fallback-only dives don't starve new work (dive_prediction_cohort_controller.py:269-296).

A GPU-less worker must not rewrite an existing row (it would be identical or a downgrade) unless its laser was superseded; it returns skipped_no_upgrade_available and the parent drops it (predict_headtail_image.py:531-553).
SAM 3.1 cannot be constructed without CUDA (PositionEmbeddingSine hardcodes device='cuda'). It raises a non-retryable ApplicationError type NoGpuForSam3 (dive 94, 356 activities looped).

SAM3 must run under torch.autocast(device_type, bfloat16) as a context manager, not __enter__, or it hits a BFloat16/Float mismatch. Feed it a PIL image, not the HWC array, or masks come out 3 px wide. Detach tensors and move them to CPU before np.asarray (predict_headtail_image.py:444-499, 360-372).

The checkpoint loader is strict=False; the expected 4 missing keys (backbone.vision_backbone.convs.3.*) are benign, any other set is a red flag. sam3.pt vs sam3.1_multiplex.pt are not interchangeable (config.py:98-120).
Fallback FishSegmentation: call load_model() before publishing the singleton, pass BGR, use landscape crops only (returns an empty mask otherwise), and split the instance label map into binary masks.

Model singletons use double-checked threading.Lock because activities run in a ThreadPoolExecutor. ensure_checkpoint uses a per-key asyncio.Lock, a temp file plus atomic os.replace, the version in the path, and writes off the event loop (checkpoint_cache.py).

The crop is centred on the FIRST laser point only; the laser gate tries every dot, first hit wins. The crop is clamped, not padded. Coordinates are lifted back to rectified-frame pixels before persisting (headtail_geometry.py).
The silhouette band 0.18-0.32 is applied at seed time (populate/backfill), not in the predictor; NULL ratio means 'not recorded' and passes (populate_...activity.py:128-181).

The LS model_version tag must be the ROW's tier (headtail_model_version_tag(row.predictor_version)) and must never include the checkpoint path or core_version; the backfill dedupes on (task_id, model_version).

The project's model_version must be set or predictions attached after import are invisible (dive 94, 334 invisible predictions). The majority tag wins, ties go to the current one; only per-dive projects ('#{dive_id}' in the title) are touched; this never raises (populate_utils.py:706-785).
The backfill lists LS predictions once per project, not per task, and attaches only to incomplete, non-superseded tasks.

The supersede pass in populate exempts rows by (same project AND image in CANDIDATES), not targets. Using targets caused the dive-341 oscillation and hid projects with outstanding work (populate_...activity.py:303-359).

One image can hold two headtail rows (uq on image_id+project_id). A PUT without a project returns 409 when the image has several rows. v1 duplicate-task history: dive 437 had 7 human labels invisible to the pipeline.

Publish only if import_result.complete and the project holds rows (never half-populated). Populate retries are bounded at 5 attempts with a 30s initial backoff, and a retry reconciles instead of re-importing (the IMPORT_ISSUED heartbeat marker; a bare heartbeat() would clear it).
JPEG presence is gated in both the predict resolver and populate. A task pointing at a missing object wedged dive 84.

The v1 head/tail sync PUTs ONLY when the task has annotations (sync_headtail_...activity.py:194-229), unlike laser sync, which always PUTs. Coordinates update only when both Snout and Fork are present; lookup skips superseded rows. Decide whether v2 keeps this quirk; the v2 laser port writes only its own columns and doesn't clear needs_reprocess.
The sync cursor advances only when every task succeeds and never moves backwards; the sync schedule is ALLOW_ALL overlap (safe because of the cursor).
Stage-5.1 rectification must stay byte-identical to the notebook (test_stage5_1_notebook_parity.py); no overlay, plain cv2.imencode default quality.

Inferred risk (not stated in v1): the preprocess cohort drains only once populate writes project rows, and populate needs predictions. When GPU and fallback are 'unavailable' for long, the lowest-id dive is re-staged from NAS and re-rendered every hour and blocks higher-id dives in stage 5.1 (ORDER BY id LIMIT 1).

Minor v1 inconsistencies to decide on, not copy blindly: views.headtail_preprocessed has no superseded filter while the selector does; the population cohort's 'no completed label' has no superseded filter; the preprocess parent comments say the child 'can run for two hours' but its execution_timeout is 1h; CLAUDE.md lines 180-197 still say headtail populate is preprocess-chained (stale); core_version is never set on predictions; rejected_low_confidence is never written.

v2 names must differ from v1's (shared Temporal until cutover): queues fishsense_processor*, and new schedule/child ids. v1 preprocess output_folder is hard-coded in the workflow (line 48), not taken from the shared constant.
